description: Input description for a CO2 capture simulation in BattMo

allOf.description: Overall model specification. Choice of physics and component that will be included in the model
Input for the control type and the corresponding parameters
Specification of the geometry including the discretization parameters
Input to setup the initial state of the battery
Input for the time stepping, see Utilities/JsonSchemas/TimeStepping.schema.json
Options for the solver, see Utilities/JsonSchemas/Solver.schema.json
Input for the choice of outputs the will be returned, see Utilities/JsonSchemas/Output.schema.json
